english_translation: I am pregnant and my legs have been swelling lately; what could be causing this and how can I be helped?
grammar_notes: Concordial Agreement (Zvivakashure): Notice how 'ndangomuka' establishes the noun class/subject frame (1st Person Sg Recent Past Concord (nda-)).
Agglutinative Morphology: 'sei' combines prefixal/suffixal morphemes (Ø- (Cl. 5/9) + -sei (root)) with tone contour H-L.
Penultimate Lengthening: In Zezuru declarative sentences, the second-to-last syllable of the phrase carries natural vowel lengthening.
cultural_notes: In Harare Zezuru standard speech, speakers maintain strict alliterative concord (zvivakashure) across noun classes while using respectful plural forms (hunhu).
